formatDuration(ms: number): string {\n459\t  if (ms < 1000) {\n460\t    return `${ms}ms`;\n461\t  }\n462\t\n463\t  const seconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);\n464\t  if (seconds < 60) {\n465\t    return this.timeSeries.filter(b => b.ts > cutoffTs);\n420\t  }\n421\t\n422\t  /**\n423\t   * Extract token counts from event\n424\t   */\n425\t  private extractTokens(event: LogEvent): { input: number;     input: (event.input_tokens as number) || 0,\n430\t        output: (event.output_tokens as number) || 0,\n431\t      };\n432\t    }\n433\t\n434\t    // Check for usage object\n435\t    const usage usage.output_tokens || 0,\n440\t      };\n441\t    }\n442\t\n443\t    // Check for token counts in message\n444\t    const msg = event.msg || '';\n445\t    const inputMatch = /**\n459\t   * Get current cost summary\n460\t   */\n461\t  getSummary(): CostSummary {\n462\t    let totalInput = 0;\n463\t    let totalOutput = 0;\n464\t    let totalCostUsd = 0;\n465\t\n466\t }\n491\t\n492\t  /**\n493\t   * Get per-bead cost breakdown, sorted by cost descending\n494\t   */\n495\t  getBeadCosts(): BeadCost[] {\n496\t    return Array.from(this.beadCosts.values())\n497\t worker: WorkerCost;\n512\t    beadCosts: Array<{ beadId: string; costUsd: number; percentOfWorker: number }>;\n513\t  } | undefined {\n514\t    const worker = this.workerCosts.get(workerId);\n515\t
